entry_item.definition: die Stirne; das Oberhaupt, der Anführer; das Vorstehende.
n. The forehead. A chief, a head, a leader, a manager. The first one (e.g. in a race).

example.definition: n. A horse that wins the race. The winner (of a horse).

entry_item.definition: n. The front-strap on a bridle crossing the forehead.
